headline.text: L2 ML3 shut down at *18:42* for contamination hold — full level-4 clean and oil flush underway.

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 3 ran Canadian S'mores all shift; early matrix issues (MM3–5) and pouch problems resolved by mid-shift, but bottom coverage quality and vendor-damaged pouches remain flagged. Sollich 2 cleared clogged pistons and ran through the last almond inventory by 03:05, finishing on schedule. Vitamin E for Feastables One-Shot is running out.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML3 was shut down at 18:42 for a contamination hold; all chocolate pulled to quarantine and a level-4 clean with oil flush is in progress. ML2 ran displays without issues. Flow wrap is short for upcoming jobs, working with Amcor on delivery.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML1 lost *3 hours* on a piston-drive fault that cleared by 01:29, then fought recurring Cavanna sensor faults through early morning — line stable by 05:43. ML4 changeover to white chocolate CNC hit delays from incomplete 3rd-shift cleaning, wrong PTL grate, and milk streaks in the push; QA approved limited production at 04:12 with scrap-on-sight inspection. Truffle Line and Matrix ran with minor quality flags.

notes.text: Bat found in plant at 20:09, removed; reinforcing door-closure discipline.
Wash caddy requested from L3 at 19:02 for ML3 clean, delivered by 21:06.
All iPads logged out of Teams at 05:41, blocking uploads from ML4 floor.

resolved.title: Sollich 3 matrix machines (MM3–5) faults during startup
resolved.summary: MM4 had zipped pouches and MM5 threw "no combination" scale errors; Troy cleaned, re-zeroed MM5, power-cycled scale, adjusted MM4 gripper arms — all three running by 07:46.
resolved.resolution: Cleared by 07:46 — "Before the line paused all 3 machines were working" (Troy Baxter).

resolved.title: S2 caramel hopper pistons clogged (4 pistons)
resolved.summary: Four pistons in caramel depositor clogged; line stopped to clean pistons, all restored to operation.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 08:27 — "All the pistons are working well after being unblocked" (S2 Enrober).

resolved.title: MM5 tapper rod jammed, not moving up/down
resolved.summary: Tapper toggled on in HMI but rod stuck; maintenance found heavy chocolate and caramel buildup preventing movement, cleaned buildup, tapping restored.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 13:28 — buildup cleaned, "tapping is now working as it should" (Troy Baxter).

resolved.title: MM4 unsealed bags, pouches dropping before seal bar
resolved.summary: Pouches dropped one side before seal bar; gripper arms adjusted to be closer together, sealing issue eliminated.
resolved.resolution: Cleared same message — "Everything is fine on MM4 now" after gripper adjustment (Troy Baxter).

resolved.title: S2 display tray shortage mid-shift
resolved.summary: Ran out of display trays at 17:15, line paused for lunch, pouches packed into WIP boxes; trays arrived 00:22, line resumed normal packing.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 00:22 — "The trays have arrived" and normal packing resumed (Elizabeth Hernandez).

resolved.title: Bat flying in production area
resolved.summary: Bat found flying around plant; supervisor caught and removed it outside, reinforced door-closure discipline.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 20:09 — bat removed, door protocols reinforced (Dakota Adair, Jorel Gourdin).

resolved.title: Water leak near drain (non-production area)
resolved.summary: Water actively pouring out near cleaned drain area; maintenance responded, restored flow through drain.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 08:40 — "The water is now flowing through the drain" (Chris Jeffs).

resolved.title: S2 M7 incorrect lot code character entered
resolved.summary: During font adjustment operator entered wrong character in lot code before QA approval; production corrected error and flagged four pallets for rework/reprint.
resolved.resolution: Corrected same shift; rework plan in place for affected pallets (Mariela Gudino, 10:05).

resolved.title: ML2 pallet marked with both version 3 & 4 labels
resolved.summary: Delivered pallet marked with both version labels; all boxes confirmed version 4, quality alerted for record.
resolved.resolution: Identified and quality alerted at 22:03 — all confirmed version 4 (Brandon Lance).

resolved.title: ML1 piston drive faulted, right side not moving
resolved.summary: Depositor piston drive threw fault at 00:23, right side stopped; maintenance found issue, cleaned and ATP-tested plate, reassembled, temper recovered, depositing resumed at 01:29.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 01:29 — plate cleaned/ATP'd, installed, temper at 0.1, "started depositing" (Raoul Lubain).

resolved.title: MFM upper sensor positions causing empty plates
resolved.summary: Faulty sensor positions not detecting empty upper plates; maintenance adjusted sensor placements, issue resolved.

resolved.title: MFM line paused, ejecting all bags (sensor fault)
resolved.summary: Matrix paused for 7 minutes, rejecting all pouches due to sensor fault; operator reset, line back up.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 23:05 — "Line is back up" after 7-minute pause (mfmatrix).

resolved.title: ML1 Cavanna sensor faults (recurring B150)
resolved.summary: Cavanna sensors failed at 03:16, cleared by 03:31, faulted again at 04:20 with chain pin damage; maintenance adjusted sensor B150, phasing belt, speed — stable by 05:43.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 05:43 — "Line is running correctly now" after sensor/belt adjustments (Nathan Ruiz, flow-wrap).

resolved.title: ML1 C5 conveyor belt shifted off track
resolved.summary: C5 belt moved out of position; maintenance realigned and tensioned belt, running correctly.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 04:16 — "Belt is running good" (Molding Line 1 Flow-Wrap).

resolved.title: ML4 milk chocolate in white chocolate push (north depositors)
resolved.summary: South depositors showing milk streaks during white push; QA approved production at 350 lbs pushed with demolding inspection and scrap-on-sight for visible streaks.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 04:12 — QA approved limited production with inspection, no streaks observed after 350 lbs (Frederick Peairs).

resolved.title: MFM basket #3 not functioning
resolved.summary: Basket #3 stopped working properly; maintenance put back into operation.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 01:25 — basket restored to operation (mfmatrix).

resolved.title: ML4 slider caps missing for depositor 1
resolved.summary: Caps for depositor 1 sliders not found in expected location; team located spares across depositor 2, swapped in place.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 02:50 — grabbed caps from across depositor 2 (Kimberly Morales).

needs_attention.status: Flagged at 09:22, 13:39, and 15:42; enrober adjustments requested but not holding.

needs_attention.title: S2 underweight almond cluster pieces
needs_attention.summary: Experiencing underweight pieces; QA informed supervisor and operator to make adjustments.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 11:49, adjustments requested; no confirmation weights corrected.

needs_attention.title: S3 MM3 pouch pickup inconsistent (rubber bumpers)
needs_attention.summary: Pouch pickup on MM3 grabbing inconsistently due to worn rubber bumpers, causing misalignment; maintenance notified, line still running but quality impact visible.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance informed at 13:16, scheduled after MM5 tapper fix; line running as of last update.

needs_attention.title: S3 MM4 excessive silvering on pouch seals
needs_attention.summary: Matrix 4 bags showing silver at seal above 3mm spec limit; operator notified to adjust but issue persists.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 13:22, requested adjustments to keep under 3mm spec; no confirmation of resolution.

needs_attention.title: Vitamin E shortage for Feastables One-Shot (item 10217)
needs_attention.summary: 20 lbs Vitamin E on hand, no inventory in Springville or second building; finishing tonight leaves ~15 lbs, enough for 10,560 lbs One-Shot before stockout.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 21:24; planning notified (Curt, Dakota, Daniel, Kirk, Ethan) but no replenishment ETA given.

needs_attention.title: S3 vendor-damaged pouches (not cut correctly)
needs_attention.summary: Receiving pouches from vendor with incorrect cuts; pictures sent to IPS for vendor follow-up.
needs_attention.status: Pictures sent to IPS at 13:25 (Ethan Bean); awaiting vendor response.

needs_attention.title: S3 pieces per pouch over spec (36–38 vs. 36 max)
needs_attention.summary: Pouch piece count running 36–38 against 36 max spec; adjustments requested to hit target.
needs_attention.status: Flagged at 18:22, Victor acknowledged "working on that" at 18:48; no follow-up confirming target hit.

needs_attention.title: ML3 contamination hold — full line shutdown
needs_attention.summary: Out of abundance of caution, ML3 shut down at 18:42; all chocolate removed to HOLD (finished goods + barrels), level-4 clean in progress with PTL flush using oil.
needs_attention.status: Shutdown ordered 18:42, draining/holding product, wash caddy delivered 21:06, clean underway as of 06:44 EOS — depositor ATP'd, ready for assembly.

needs_attention.summary: 1.78M rolls needed, 19.9M on order; ETA requested from Amcor for 5M delivery.
needs_attention.status: Ethan working with Amcor as of 11:29, no ETA confirmed; Alex requested level-1 FW pull from L3 at 06:58 (2 hours on line).

needs_attention.summary: Operator pulled hose from sink, sweco lid came out with hose and fell on ground; contamination event.

needs_attention.summary: 2nd shift left chiller and temper unit in production programs instead of shutdown; 3rd shift doing reheat to empty buffer tank.
needs_attention.status: Flagged at 23:11, reheat underway to drain buffer; procedural miss from 2nd shift.

needs_attention.summary: Machine stopped dispensing chocolate; operator attempting hard reset.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 19:37, trying hard reset; no follow-up confirming restoration.

needs_attention.summary: Multiple cleaning sections from 3rd shift either incomplete or not updated on checklist; 1st shift asking for status.
